{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any status is 'refunded'
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of channel
print("Channel distribution:")
print(data['channel'].value_counts())

# Print the first few rows to confirm structure
print("\nFirst few rows of cleaned data:")
print(data.head())"}
